trivia_fact: GCP's container story traces a direct lineage: Google ran Borg internally since 2003, evolved it into Omega, then open-sourced the concepts as Kubernetes in 2014. Three Googlers (Joe Beda, Brendan Burns, Craig McLuckie) created K8s using lessons from a decade of Borg.

BigQuery is the public version of Google's Dremel system, described in a 2010 paper. Dremel pioneered columnar storage with tree-based query execution, enabling interactive SQL over petabytes. The name "Dremel" comes from the rotary tool brand — it "drills into data."
